meta.name: remote-collection
meta.description: Configure and troubleshoot CCAM Remote Data Sources that collect Claude Code and Codex history over SSH. Use when adding, editing, testing, syncing, or removing a remote machine, verifying provider paths, or deciding whether to retain or purge imported sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 配置并排查远程数据源,同步与管理编码会话历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在多台机器上编程并希望集中管理 AI 编码会话记录
copy.tagline_en: Configure remote data sources to collect and manage coding history over SSH.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code on several machines and want to consolidate your AI coding session history.

howto.what: Claude 会按 remote-collection 流程帮你管理通过 SSH 收集 Claude Code 和 Codex 远程历史的数据源:列出已配置机器、按现有 SSH 配置校验主机、添加/修改源、测试后同步,并在删除前说明导入数据保留还是清除。
howto.when: 当你要求新增、编辑或删除远程机器,或测试/同步数据源,或判断删除后是否保留导入数据时触发。

say.text: 列出当前配置的远程数据源。
先测试 001 号远程源,再同步它。
say.note: Claude 会运行 test 和 sync 命令。

say.text: 删除远程源 002,并清除已导入数据。

howto.what_en: Claude manages SSH-based CCAM remote data sources for Claude Code/Codex history: list sources, validate via SSH config, add/edit, test before sync, and state keep/purge before removal.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add, edit, or delete a remote machine; test or sync a data source; or decide whether imported sessions should be kept or purged.

say_en.text: List the currently configured remote sources.
say_en.note: Claude runs ccam remote-sources and explains the output.

say_en.text: Test remote source 001, then sync it.
say_en.note: Claude runs the test and sync commands.

say_en.text: Remove remote source 002 and purge its imported data.
say_en.note: Claude states data will be purged, then removes it with --purge.
